project.summary: Read-only runtime management panel for the official DeepSeek Harness MCP client: /mcp command and a Settings tab with connection status, registered tools, errors and reconnect counts.

release.compatibility: DeepSeek Harness >= 0.1.0-rc.5 (peer dependencies pin the 0.1.0-rc.6 package line)

management.label: Profile Bundle (cordis.patch.yml via dsh plugin add)
management.instructions: Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-panel@0.3.0` (or `github:PerryLink/dsh-mcp-panel#v0.3.0`), then restart or let the web surface hot-reload its cordis.patch.yml. Manual fallback: place the package in the profile node_modules and add the documented mcp-panel row to cordis.patch.yml.

declarations.permissions: network:outbound (one-shot and optional passive Streamable HTTP probes to user-configured endpoints); native-code:none. No filesystem writes; loader entries and the tool registry are read in-process.
declarations.testing: 109 vitest unit tests; full gate: typecheck (checkout + npm faces), test, build, verify:self-contained, verify:artifacts; end-to-end headless /mcp run against a real web profile.

capability.expected: lists configured MCP servers with connection status, tool counts, last errors and reconnect counts, with localized output

review.notes: Automatically prepared from #16; public fixed-source preflight passed. Human review is still required.
